claims.text: Psyllium (Metamucil) adults 12 and over: 1 packet in 8 oz of liquid, up to 3 times daily.
claims.quote: | Adults 12 yrs. & older | 1 packet in 8 oz of liquid at the first sign of irregularity. Can be taken up to 3 times daily.

claims.text: Stop and ask a doctor if constipation lasts more than 7 days, rectal bleeding occurs or there's no bowel movement.
claims.quote: • constipation lasts more than 7 days • rectal bleeding occurs • you fail to have a bowel movement
